privacy.title: Everything stays on your computer.
privacy.body: Your data is safe; searches run locally.
health.offline: Nothing leaves this computer. No internet connection is used.
panel.label: Status panel
panel.noFolders: No folders yet. Add one to start searching.
search.label: Search
search.tagline: Explore your files, notes and past conversations with AI.
search.placeholder: Ask about a file, note or past conversation...
search.needsEmbedding: Search is off until EmbeddingGemma 2 is installed and loaded.
search.degraded: No LLM used — request read by rules only
search.bestMatches.one: This is the best match in your folders:
search.bestMatches.other: These are the best matches in your folders:
search.clarify.one: I found 1 match. Is this the one?
search.clarify.other: I found {n} matches in {projects} projects. Which one was it?
search.clarifyShort: Results in more than one project. Which one?
search.notFoundWhy: I searched the folders you allowed; I won't show a made-up result.
search.notFoundShort: Try other words or add a folder.
search.modeLater: This search mode arrives with the search engine (P2).
preview.label: Preview
preview.readOnly: Read-only preview. The file is not changed.
voice.title: Voice search
voice.unavailable: Voice search needs an STT model
voice.heard: What I heard — you can edit it
memory.sub: Past searches are kept on this computer. Unloading a model doesn't erase them.
memory.deleteNote: Deleting removes the queries, matches and open records for good. Source files are not touched.
models.sub: Models run on this computer. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
models.swapNote: Replacing it builds a new index; old vectors are never mixed.
models.desc.llm: Optional. Reads requests better: synonyms, dates, file types, follow-ups, one clarifying question.
models.desc.stt: Optional. Enables voice search; typing always works.
models.desc.tts: Optional. Reads answers aloud; text is always shown.
models.p4Note: Model loading arrives with the model manager (P4). Until then this list is read-only.
model.err.voice_profile_missing: The voice profile file (*.onnx.json) is missing. Answers are shown as text.
model.err.runtime_missing: llama-server was not found. Install llama.cpp to load this model.
addModel.title: Add model
addModel.pickTitle: Choose a model file or folder
addModel.inPlace: Files are used in place, not copied.
addModel.supported.embedding: Supported: EmbeddingGemma 2 GGUF folder (model + mmproj for images and audio).
addModel.supported.llm: Supported: a GGUF instruction model with a chat template (tested: Gemma 4 E2B-it).
addModel.fail.format.embedding: No EmbeddingGemma 2 GGUF was found here.
addModel.fail.runtime: llama-server was not found. Install llama.cpp (winget install ggml.llamacpp) and try again.
addModel.fail.smoke: The test run failed. Update llama.cpp (winget upgrade ggml.llamacpp) and try again.
addModel.fail.notYet: This model type is supported in a later version.
addModel.fail.format.llm: No GGUF instruction model (with a chat template) found here.
addModel.note: Registering doesn't mean it will run. After the test passes it shows as “On disk”; it turns green only when loaded.
addModel.failedNote: This model can't be used. Nothing was saved.
addModel.savedToast: {name} added. Load it when you need it.
folders.sub: Only folders you allow are searched. Files are read, never changed.
folders.emptyBody: Choose a folder to search. You'll see a preview first.
folders.unreachableMeta: Not found at its place · hidden from results · use Relink if it was moved
folders.exclusionsLater: Editing exclusions arrives in a later version.
folders.foot: A folder is scanned when you add it or press “Scan now”; automatic watching arrives later. “Remove & purge” = gone from search at once and its index is erased. Your files are never changed or deleted.
folders.previewNote: A preview is scanned first. Nothing is indexed until you confirm.
folders.previewDone: Preview done. Nothing has been indexed yet.
folders.riskAccept: I understand the risks; {path} may be scanned.
revoke.title: Remove {path}?
revoke.insideParent: This folder is also inside the allowed folder {parent}.
revoke.blockBody: Never scanned again, even though the parent is allowed. Its index is erased now.
revoke.purgeBody: Gone from search now; its index is erased.
revoke.stopBody: Keeps the index; no new scans.
revoke.history: Also delete history that came from this folder
revoke.note: Your files are never deleted. If purging is interrupted, it continues on next start.
settings.hotkeyHint: Opens and hides the widget from anywhere.
settings.hotkeyConflict: {key} is used by another app. Choose another.
settings.hotkeyInactive: The current shortcut is taken by another app. Choose another.
settings.measuredNote: Values appear once measured; no estimates are shown.
settings.wipeBody: History and indexes on this computer are erased. Model files and your documents are not touched.
welcome.title: Welcome to Tamgabul
welcome.lead: Ready in four steps. Everything stays on this computer; no model is downloaded automatically.
welcome.embDesc: The search engine. Choose the model folder on your computer.
welcome.embLoad: Installed. Load it to turn search on.
welcome.optionalDesc: Typed search works without them. Add them later from Models.
welcome.folderDesc: Pick where to search. You'll see a preview first.
welcome.foot: Search turns on when EmbeddingGemma 2 is ready. Folders and settings work now.
widget.hint: Ask in your own words, e.g. “the timer bug I found last week”.
widget.seeAll.one: See the result in the app

error.RUNTIME_LOAD_FAILED.title: The model didn't start
error.RUNTIME_LOAD_FAILED.body: Try loading it again, or check its files.
error.INFERENCE_TIMEOUT.title: That took too long
error.INFERENCE_TIMEOUT.body: Try again; a smaller model may help.
error.EMBEDDING_GENERATION_STALE.title: The index is out of date
error.EMBEDDING_GENERATION_STALE.body: Rebuild the index after changing the model.
error.SCOPE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.title: This folder isn't allowed
error.SCOPE_REVOKED.title: This folder was removed or can't be reached
error.SCOPE_REVOKED.body: Relink it or add it again.
error.SOURCE_CHANGED.title: The file moved or changed

error.INDEX_UNAVAILABLE.title: The index isn't ready
error.MIC_PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Microphone access was denied
error.MIC_PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Type your search instead, or allow the microphone in system settings.
error.DB_MIGRATION_FAILED.title: The local database couldn't open
error.DB_MIGRATION_FAILED.body: Your data was backed up. Restart Tamgabul; if it happens again, check the diagnostic log.
error.USER_CANCELLED.title: Cancelled
error.HOTKEY_CONFLICT.title: That shortcut is taken
error.NOT_IMPLEMENTED.title: Not available yet
error.NOT_IMPLEMENTED.body: This part arrives with its backend phase.
error.INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong
